author: security-reviewer

findings.description: Parity question, not a defect in this change and not blocking. The clamp added to OwnerController.processFindForm removes an unhandled-exception path for page<1 that previously reached the error page, which per REQ-SYS-002 renders the underlying exception message. VetController.showVetList carries the identical unclamped pattern (PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize)) on /vets.html and still exposes that path. It is pre-existing and outside this change set, so it is correctly not a finding against this diff; the question is whether the PRD intends the same first-page fallback for the veterinarian listing, or whether REQ-OWN-002 is deliberately scoped to owner search alone.

approved_aspects: No new trust boundary is crossed: the change hardens an existing one. The page request parameter is now clamped with Math.max(page, FIRST_PAGE) before any use, so validation happens at the boundary before the value reaches data access, exactly as docs/security-principles.md prescribes.

Integer-underflow angle closed. Before the change, page=Integer.MIN_VALUE flowed into page - 1 and wrapped to Integer.MAX_VALUE; the clamp now guarantees page >= 1 at the subtraction, so page - FIRST_PAGE can no longer underflow. Both values in the new test (0 and -3) exercise the clamp.

Error-disclosure surface reduced, not widened. The prior behavior threw IllegalArgumentException from PageRequest.of and rendered it through the error page, which docs/prd.md REQ-SYS-002 records as a detail-leaking defect. The fix removes that reachable path for below-range page values, leaving the application strictly stronger than the baseline in system-design.md#security-context.

No injection surface touched. Data access still goes through the Spring Data derived query owners.findByLastNameStartingWith with a Pageable; no query text is concatenated and no request-derived value composes a path or resource name.

No output-escaping change. currentPage is added to the model as a primitive int and rendered through Thymeleaf's default escaping, which the change does not disable; no request-derived markup reaches the DOM.
Mass-assignment control intact. The @InitBinder disallow list for id and *.id is unchanged, and the new parameter is a primitive bound outside the Owner command object.

Resource-consumption angle assessed and unchanged. An arbitrarily large page still produces a large OFFSET, but that path existed identically before this change; the diff neither introduces nor widens it, and the clamp removes the one page value that previously caused an exception rather than an empty result.

Supply chain clean: scripts/changeset.sh --name-only shows only OwnerController.java and OwnerControllerTests.java. No build.gradle, settings.gradle, pom.xml, or wrapper change, therefore no new or upgraded dependency and no new artifact resolution to verify.
Class sweep complete. Grepped the production tree for PageRequest.of and @RequestParam(defaultValue; the only occurrence inside the change set is the one under review and it is correctly clamped.

author: test-reviewer

findings.description: New test method name `processFindFormWithPageBelowOneShowsFirstPage` mirrors the production method name instead of stating the behavior. testing-principles.md § Test Naming requires the BDD school (`the{Subject}Should{Outcome}`) for tests written from 2026-07-31 onward; this test is new as of this change.
findings.fix: Rename to a behavior-stating name, e.g. `theOwnerSearchShouldShowFirstPageWhenRequestedPageIsBelowOne`.

findings.description: The new test iterates page values `0` and `-3` in a `for` loop inside the test body. testing-principles.md Test Structure / Assertions rules and the test-review checklist require straight-line test bodies (no loops) and `@ParameterizedTest` for repetitive cases; the two bare literal page values are also unnamed Tier-1 data, contrary to the Three-Tier Data Naming convention.
findings.fix: Convert to `@ParameterizedTest` with `@ValueSource(ints = {0, -3})` (or `@CsvSource` with one comment per case), naming the parameter to make the meaningful value explicit instead of looping over a `List.of(...)`.

approved_aspects: Fix is exercised through the real MVC dispatch via MockMvc (sanctioned boundary mock), not a controller unit stub
Test asserts on the actual behavior contract (currentPage model attribute clamped to 1, status ok, correct view) rather than internal implementation detail
./gradlew test passes cleanly for OwnerControllerTests including the new case
Boundary coverage includes both a zero and a negative page value, matching the bug's reported symptom

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owner search page parameter to the first page

blast_radius.note: Two files, one controller method and its test; 12 production lines across 7 hunks, no sensitive paths, and the two modules are only the main/test split of a single package.

semantic_surprise.note: The hunks do exactly what the description says: Math.max(page, FIRST_PAGE) at method entry, and both downstream uses switched to currentPage so the query index and the currentPage model attribute the pagination links read stay in step; reusing FIRST_PAGE as the one-based-to-zero-based offset inside PageRequest.of conflates two meanings of the number 1 but changes no behavior.

test_adequacy.note: The parameterized MockMvc test drives the real dispatch for page 0 and -3 and asserts currentPage equals 1, which fails against the unclamped code and against a wrong clamp such as absolute value, so it is not a restatement of the implementation.

reviewer_hedging.note: The security reviewer approved with an open clarify finding routed to product-requirements-expert asking whether VetController.showVetList should get the same treatment; it is still listed unresolved in the fix-pass plan open_findings and no consultation or PRD record answers it.

scope_deviation.note: Zero design revisions, consultations, and build retries; the diff stays inside processFindForm and its paging helper, the surface REQ-OWN-002 names, and deliberately does not reach into the vet listing.

rationale: The fix itself reads clean and the test is real. The residual is the security reviewer's unanswered parity question: VetController.showVetList still calls PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) unclamped, so /vets.html?page=0 keeps throwing the error this change removed for owners. Decide whether that is a deliberate scope line or a follow-up requirement.
